name: android_drag
description: Performs a smooth, controlled drag gesture between two points (default duration 1000ms) for timeline seekbars, volume sliders, and list reordering.

startX.description: Start X coordinate (normalized 0.0-1.0 or exact pixels).

startY.description: Start Y coordinate (normalized 0.0-1.0 or exact pixels).

endX.description: End X coordinate (normalized 0.0-1.0 or exact pixels).

endY.description: End Y coordinate (normalized 0.0-1.0 or exact pixels).
